topic: How does the 41% efficiency of the proposed antenna impact link budget calculations for GEO-LEO satellite links?
consensus_response: The 41% efficiency of the proposed antenna significantly impacts link budget calculations for GEO-LEO satellite links, reducing the effective gain and increasing the noise temperature. This necessitates a careful consideration of the trade-offs between antenna size and transmission power, and implementing design modifications to improve antenna efficiency can mitigate these effects. Optimizing antenna design, materials, and manufacturing techniques, as well as incorporating active elements or advanced RF circuits, can help achieve higher efficiencies and improve system performance.
